propositions: Plan-review Pass 1 can serialize failed criteria as empty successes with checkpoints missing policy, prompt, contract, and topology inputs, losing operational context.

RP-06 must migrate plan-review discovery execution to the S2 shared typed kernel while preserving YAML topology, facet packing, fallback ladder, centrality budget, bounded concurrency, cache warming, container/prerequisite stages, cancellation, and resumable checkpoints.

The new checkpoint key must incorporate material, code/ref, policy, prompt, contract, model/mode, topology, context, dependencies, and namespace version; corrupt and legacy entries must produce zero reuse.
Failed, cancelled, skipped, and budget-shed work must remain missing and remain callable on rerun; only content-identical success/resume envelopes seed reuse.

After local operation exhaustion, the approved failure policy must preserve successful findings, skip dependents of missing work, return unsigned INDETERMINATE for missing blocking-capable coverage unless a blocking finding wins, and allow advisory-only gaps to pass.

The reducer-ignored review journal must store safe versioned traces and digest-complete success-only checkpoint envelopes, while review-plan outputs remain narrow end-result contracts with no per-unit trace.
